t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Each coloured pair will give a certain amount of points so it's important to keep choosing that one until it changes then you want to switch to the other one. Try to switch when it's at x1 to not risk losing as many potential bonus points

vb_textbox.text: The gnomes always appear in the same colour combination and can only pay up to 7 points. Figure out which one pays more points and continue to select that one until it becomes less than 4 and then start choosing that colour in order to optimize your points!
